card.name: The word or introducing an equivalent figure
card.fires_on: The word "or" right after a count, dose or fraction, where it introduces the same amount in another form (a percentage, a multiple, or a different unit).

modes.label: Count then percent
modes.description: "or" follows a patient count or fraction and gives the percentage.

modes.label: Dose then equivalent
modes.description: "or" follows a dose and gives an equal dose or a multiple of the human dose.
modes.example: at doses of up to 16 mg/kg/day,<< or>> approximately 5 times the MRHD on

modes.label: Number inside a count
modes.description: A rarer case on a digit or word inside a count, just before the percentage in parentheses.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning "approximately" or "that is", which prepare a restated equivalent value.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a number is about to be restated in another form, like "or about 2%".
